name: @forest-rs/layerstack-demo
description: A plain-DOM walkthrough of @forest-rs/layerstack's API over a layered sample: the explicit asset loop, explain, edits (through a reference, a variant, define and retype, rename), undo history, save and reopen, layer muting, materials and collections as data, change records and transfer counters. The scene editor with a viewport is packages/editor.
